newsitem.title: USA: General DataComm, Encore to collaborate.
newsitem.headline: General DataComm, Encore to collaborate.

text.p: General DataComm Industries Inc and Encore Computer Corp said on Monday they will collaborate on sales and marketing with products that offer data storage, retrieval and data sharing technologies over unlimited distances.

The companies said they have integrated storage with Asynchronous Transfer Mode (ATM) wide area broadband services. Their approach will incorporate Encore's Infinity SP universal storage processors and General DataComm's multimedia access concentration switches.

General DataComm, based in Middlebury, Conn., makes equipment and products for data-transmiting networks. Encore, based in Fort Lauderdale, provides data storage, retrieval and sharing technologies for mixed-platform processing environments.
